This leaves is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known throughout Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

To obtain its properties, it is inhaled.

Inhaled leaves produce a mixture of euphoria, stimulation, and hallucinations. The substance is sought after as a drug and carries a significant risk of addiction.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
